input: Get a second opinion on the knee surgery recommendation

gold.taskTitle: Get a Second Opinion on Knee Surgery
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to seek a second medical opinion regarding a knee surgery recommendation they have received.

questions.title: What type of knee surgery has been recommended to you?
questions.description: Understand the specific procedure recommended, e.g., ACL reconstruction, knee replacement, meniscus repair.

questions.title: Which medical specialty did the first doctor belong to?
questions.description: Identify whether the original recommendation came from an orthopedic surgeon, sports medicine doctor, or general practitioner.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred location for the second opinion?
questions.description: Determine if the user wants a local specialist, a specific hospital or clinic, or is open to telehealth options.

questions.title: Do you have a timeline or deadline driving this decision?
questions.description: Find out if there is urgency, such as a scheduled surgery date, worsening symptoms, or an insurance deadline.

questions.title: Does your insurance cover second opinion consultations?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user needs to work within insurance constraints or is prepared to pay out of pocket.

questions.title: What medical records or imaging do you currently have?
questions.description: Identify what documentation the user already holds, such as MRI scans, X-rays, or written diagnosis reports.

questions.title: What is your main concern about the original recommendation?
questions.description: Understand the core reason for seeking a second opinion, such as doubts about necessity, risks, recovery time, or alternative treatments.
